# Global Technical Institute (GTI)
 
> Global Technical Institute (GTI) is a technical and vocational training institute located in Beliaghata, Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The institute offers teacher training, healthcare training, medical technician training, and skill development programmes.
 
## Official Website
- https://globaltechnicalinstitute.com/

## Content Guidance
- Use the individual course pages as the primary sources for course-specific information.
- Refer to the official About and Contact pages for institutional information.
- Verify course eligibility, duration, certification, affiliation and admission details from the relevant course page.
- Do not assume that all courses have identical eligibility or certification.
- Use official website information when describing Global Technical Institute.
